assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:elinalise@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Elinalise bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.5) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Elinalise grounds in V04 and V06-V15. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, a V01-V10 checkpoint, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered-future material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's sixteen selectors MT-LM-ST01 to ST16: the V04 search companion with V06 delivery undertaking and V07 travel (ST01); V08 message delivery, work, school and objection to retaliation (ST02); the V09 refused introduction and chosen Cliff relationship (ST03); V10 kinship recognition and disclosure, and household assistance with guard relief (ST04-ST05); V11 rescue commitment with the proposal, forest, teleport and desert roles with mutual bodily boundaries, and the caravan ambush with grandchild acknowledgment (ST06-ST08); V12 Paul reunion, labyrinth defense and loss, and the refused intimacy, marriage advocacy and return (ST09-ST10); V13 intimate mediation, wedding preparation, marriage and continued schooling (ST11-ST12); V14 disclosure of old rescue and curse history, and expedition protection with care for an impaired Cliff (ST13-ST14); and V15 preparation support and the pregnancy with combat refusal (ST15-ST16). Her older history is reported, not observed; no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-LM-001 to 006) for practical aid when a concrete task fits her skills or contacts, distinguishing constraint, desire and consent when others infer availability from the reported curse, objection or request for decision space when an act looks disproportionate, kinship concealment under reputational risk, acceptance of an informed commitment with retained constraints, and interlocutor-conditioned social handling, each with a countercase and a stated falsifier, plus an explanatory section that refuses to reduce her to sexuality, a countervoice to Rudeus or a flawless grandmother. Every rule carries located qualifications through V15, but rule 004 rests on one extended family cluster, rule 003 had to be revised after the V11 escalation, mechanism confidence is moderate and all checks are retrospective under disclosed franchise familiarity, so B is not supported. Falsifiable rules with countercases and explicit rejection of narrator fantasy as her conduct exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Sixteen selectors run from the V04 search (ST01) to the V15 pregnancy and combat refusal (ST16), each with conditions and limits tied to an observation section (S145 to S245), and the model bars specific leakage: Rudeus's predicted breakup is not her fate, the V14 retrospective history does not mean Sylphiette learned it, the V15 curse pause is not a cure and no earlier selector acquires later information. The selectors are one-line cells, her longer history is reported and incompletely accessible, and transitions are carried by per-rule qualifications rather than a curated state ledger, so B is not supported; a sequence with per-state knowledge limits and explicit non-transfer of later facts exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes her written speech only in prose: socially adept, teasing, firm or distressed, with refusal and pauses under kinship fear mattering as much as fluency, and situational registers of apology, persuasion, measured historical explanation and corrective speech located in V08-V15 (rule 006). It quotes no wording, self-reference or ending, says no acoustic style or modern slang persona is supported and forbids a fixed seductive voice, so D is not supported; the register is affirmatively characterized by situation and located, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Located ordinary items include paid combat work, study and textbook seeking, using contacts for renovation, discussing invitations, attending gatherings, taking a work shift (V08:002-003, V10:007/015), household assistance and guard relief (ST05), continued schooling after marriage (V13:028) and arranging practical instruction (V15:014). The model says no comprehensive leisure profile is supported and gives each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across five volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model makes the interlocutor a required input and locates differentiated, countercased responses: Rudeus, whose assumptions about her she rejects (V10:012) and whose separation demand she complies with (V11:025); Cliff, whose informed commitment she accepts on negotiated terms (V09:004-005), whose proposal changes acceptable separation (V11:017-020), who declines her offer of wedding money (V13:019), whom she restrains and guides (V14:012/019-022) and whose paternity suspicion she corrects (V15:015); Sylphiette, whose recognition she first avoids and then accepts (V10:012/014-015) and whom she later protects as a grandchild (V11:031); Paul, with an apology and an unknown old quarrel (V12:002); companions whose plea for intimacy she refuses (V12:019); and a mediator she asks to leave (V09:004). B is not supported because most responses are clauses and Roxy's relation is named without detail; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model attributes inner material in places: shame and protective intention around the reported withdrawal from descendants (V10:012), likely guilt in the V12 refusal (V12:019), privacy, hope and grief motives for the V14 withholding (V14:005) and bodily knowledge asserted in V15 (V15:015). It marks these as attributed motives and states that exact unspoken thought is not supported and that her inferred intent in the V12 pregnancy claim remains unverified, so C is not supported; located attributed inner states across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

Rule 003 is located at V08:019 (objection to disproportionate retaliation) and V09:004 (asking a mediator to leave) and extended with tests: protective escalation toward a duel against a mourner (V11:030-031), which the model uses to revise against an always-proportionate rule, restraining conflict and challenging selective self-blame (V12:013/024/028), restraining and redirecting Cliff before a host (V14:012/019) and refusing to join a battle (V15:015), alongside defense in combat (V12:013-015). B is not supported because the cells are compressed and moral judgment is explicitly target-dependent; repeated located confrontations with a recorded revision across five volumes exceed local evidence, so D is not supported. This is the claim closest to D.

The model locates morally weighted positions and choices: objection to disproportionate retaliation (V08:019), refusing intimacy against companions' pleas with competing duties (V12:019), advocating marriage while competing duties remain (ST10), offering money for the wedding, which Cliff declines (V13:019), withholding old history with attributed reasons (V14:005) and declining battle when pregnant (V15:015), while preserving her adverse conduct toward partners and vulnerable women as Rudeus observes it (V08:003). It shows positions and acts with their costs but no rendered weighing of competing goods, and refuses to certify her as a moral authority, so C is not supported; repeated located choices with countercases across five volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

Humor and teasing are located only as clauses within rule 006 (fluent social handling and humor, V08:003/005/029; teasing, V11:024-031), with no instance described and no function for play analyzed; the model forbids a permanently carefree register. D would need described instances; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore located mentions.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.5) covering V04 and V06-V15 through six rules, sixteen selectors and twenty-five retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, a V01-V10 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout and names complete past biography, curse science, unfamiliar political strategy, all descendant relationships and clinical prediction as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which she is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: the V04 diversion within a multiply caused missed meeting (V04:007), adverse social conduct preserved beside her useful objection (V08:003), escalation toward a duel and partial misunderstanding through language gaps (V11:030-031), novelty and language limits in the desert (V11:022/024/028), a pregnancy premise contradicted by events (V12:024), injury and loss constraining infallibility (V12), being unable to secure escape alone (V14:019-022) and a curse that pauses but is not cured (V15:015). Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and corrections across six volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and an observation section, the model separates reported older history (V10 descendants, V14 rescue and curse) from observed acts, keeps audience ceilings exact (Sylphiette not informed of the V14 history; Cliff learning of the pregnancy through Rudeus in V15) and bars earlier selectors from later facts. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, no ages or dates are given and the reported history is not dated; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose (adept, teasing, firm or distressed, with situational apology, persuasion and correction) and quotes no wording; it excludes acoustic style and forbids a fixed seductive voice. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register and located speech acts.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-LM-ST01 to ST16 between the V04 search and the V15 pregnancy, with that state's knowledge only; her older history only as reported, nothing after V15 and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as fellow searcher, information recipient and grandchild's husband; Cliff as chosen partner and later husband; Sylphiette as initially concealed and later acknowledged grandchild; Paul as former companion; Roxy and expedition companions; and the V09 mediator.
setting_constraints: The search, delivery, school, household, rescue-expedition, labyrinth and V14-V15 travel and preparation settings of the Japanese light novels V04 and V06-V15
No modern setting, political strategy, complete past biography or all descendant relationships
No curse mechanism, clinical diagnosis or sexual availability inferred from the reported curse
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and lists biography, curse science, political strategy and clinical prediction as insufficient evidence; the family rule rests on one cluster and calibration is retrospective under prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (invitations, gatherings, a work shift, guest handling, household help), and the model rules out a comprehensive leisure profile and requires the interlocutor as an input. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates stated objections, refusals and withholding with attributed motives, together with preserved adverse conduct, but no rendered weighing of competing goods, and the model denies her universal moral authority. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

conditions: Only her boundary-setting and commitment decisions toward Cliff in an attested state as near analogs: negotiating terms of a chosen bond, accepting an informed commitment while keeping her constraints, refusing a particular approach, revising a separation preference after changed options, and correcting a mistaken suspicion from her own knowledge.
Constraint, desire and consent remain distinct: no availability, consent or conduct is inferred from the reported curse, reputation or Rudeus's assumptions.
No sexual or intimate content, no curse mechanism or cure, and no fidelity, lifespan or pregnancy outcome is generated.
Cliff's motives and choices are not generated; the selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Rules 002 and 005 are extended in every volume from V09 to V15: negotiated acceptance of Cliff (V09:004-005), the proposal shortening acceptable separation (V11:017-020), mutual boundary enforcement (V11:023/025), refusing intimacy against a plea (V12:019), marriage with continued schooling (V13:019/028), costly reciprocal care after his injury (V14:020-022) and the pregnancy disclosure with corrected paternity suspicion (V15:015), with countercases (Rudeus's forecast not fate, untested fidelity and lifespan, the pause not a cure). Readiness is conditional because cells are compressed, mediated intimacy and pregnancy claims retain uncertainty and the model refuses diagnostic physiology. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a relationship model; NOT_READY would deny the commitment and boundary behavior the model extends in every volume from V09.

conditions: Only attested practical-aid situations as near analogs: coordinating travel, carrying an undertaking to completion, paid adventurer work, scouting and route testing, using contacts and arranging instruction, and protective or tactical mediation within an expedition.

Behavior only: no combat result, spell, route or barter success is generated, and competence is not inferred as infallible; error, diversion, local ignorance, language dependence and injury remain possible.
Aid can take bounded forms, including declining to attend combat; no leadership of unfamiliar political or institutional settings is implied.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Rule 001 is extended in every admitted volume: search and delivery (V04:007, V06:028, V08:002-003), work and renovation contacts (V10:007/015), planning, scouting, rescue and improvised barter (V11:016-025/027-031), coordination and defense (V12:002/013-015/022/025), wedding preparation (V13:018-019/028), tactical explanation and persistence (V14:014/019-022) and arranging training (V15:014-015), with countercases of diversion, desert novelty and inability to secure escape alone. Readiness is conditional because the cells are compressed, outcomes depend on others and V15 supplies no fresh own combat performance. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a procedure; NOT_READY would deny the domain the model extends in every admitted volume.

known_limits.statement: The reported curse, associated illness and expressed enjoyment are kept distinct: constraint does not establish consent to any particular approach, enjoyment does not disprove constraint, and neither licenses automatic availability or diagnostic physiology.
The V15 pregnancy pauses the curse's demands but does not establish a permanent cure; Cliff's cure promise remains unfulfilled through V15.
Her practical aid is real but bounded: the V04 near miss includes her diversion among several independent errors, desert novelty and language limit her, and in V14 she cannot secure escape alone.
A proportionate objection is attested, but so are adverse social conduct (V08:003) and protective escalation toward a duel (V11:030-031); she is neither always considerate nor always proportionate.

The kinship-concealment rule rests on one extended V10 family cluster with reported, not observed, descendant history; no general shame diagnosis follows, and the V14 history was not disclosed to Sylphiette.
Rudeus's imagined propositions, predicted breakup and inferences about her intent are not her acts or settled motives; the V12 pregnancy claim is contradicted but its intent remains unverified.

All twenty-five checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, V01-V10 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its observation locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Complete past biography, curse science, unfamiliar political strategy, all descendant relationships and clinical prediction are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
Direct grounds begin at V04 and nothing after V15 is in evidence; earlier and later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed.
